description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Pure is hiring a Software Engineer to join its team and own full features from design handoff through production. The role works across the stack, contributing to the app and social layer, real-time game engine, and payments and compliance systems.
Full-stack software engineer building social apps, game engines, and payments-compliance features

Responsibilities:
• Own full features from design handoff through production
• Work across the stack and move fast, touching whatever needs to get done
• Build across the product's three main technical areas: the app and social layer, the game engine, and payments and compliance

Requirements:
• BS or equivalent in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field
• Some hands-on development experience: internships, full-time roles, and/or personal projects
• Attention to detail, particularly on frontend/UI implementation and overall user flows
• Strong work ethic and comfort operating in an environment with ambiguity
